🤖 China’s humanoid robots are getting seriously fast.

At the 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, more than 2,000 robots from 666 teams across 16 countries are set to compete in over 30 events from August 22–26.

One robot nicknamed Superman reportedly hit 12.66 m/s in testing, a speed that would even edge past Usain Bolt’s recorded peak speed.

Beyond racing, the robots will take on weightlifting, tug-of-war, firefighting, and other real-world challenges, showing just how quickly humanoid movement and coordination are improving.
